event_downed: A Cannon Tortoise lies half-buried in the sand, its shell cracked and cannons silent. Its Core still glows faintly.
event_downed_repair_ambush: The Cannon Tortoise reactivates aggressively and opens fire!
event_downed_repair_buff: The Cannon Tortoise stabilizes and will watch over you until the exit!
event_downed_repair_cannon: The grateful Cannon Tortoise offers you one of its cannons before powering down!
event_downed_salvage_damage: The Cannon Tortoise fires one last shot before shutting down completely!
event_downed_salvage_preserver: You carefully extract intact components from the Cannon Tortoise!
event_downed_salvage_saver: You find rare synchronization devices among the wreckage!
event_downed_salvage_wild: The Cannon Tortoise was only resting! It wakes up furious!
event_device: You find an ancient Zoidian device half-buried in the rubble.
event_device_activate_ambush: The device emits a sound that is attracting nearby Zoids. Prepare to fight!
event_device_activate_heal: The device activates a repair field that restores your Zoids!
event_device_take_damage: The device emits a shock as you grab it!
event_device_take_reward: This must be worth a fortune!
event_chamber: You discover a sealed chamber behind a collapsed wall. Ancient symbols glow faintly on its surface.
event_chamber_analyze_ambush: Your scanner picks up movement inside — aggressive Zoids were lurking behind the wall!
event_chamber_analyze_reward: The scan reveals ancient data patterns. This information is incredibly valuable!
event_chamber_open_ambush: The chamber's ancient defense system activates! Zoids emerge from within!
event_chamber_open_reward: Inside you find a large chamber full of ancient scrap worth a fortune!
event_patrol: You spot a patrol scanning the area. Their scout Molga moves cautiously through the ruins.
event_patrol_confront_fight: The Imperial scout spots you and engages!
event_patrol_confront_flee: The scout panics and retreats, leaving supplies behind!
event_patrol_hide_reward: You wait until they pass and find metal scraps they left behind!
event_patrol_hide_spotted: They spot you hiding! The scout opens fire before retreating!
event_creature: A small metallic creature emerges from the shadows, too small to be a Zoid...
event_creature_approach_ambush: It was a trap! Wild Zoids emerge from the shadows!
event_creature_approach_heal: The creature shyly approaches your Zoids and emanates a light that begins to repair them.
event_creature_provoke_damage: The creature emits a burst of energy that damages your Zoids before fleeing!
event_creature_provoke_jackpot: The creature drops a massive chunk of rare metal and flees!
event_creature_provoke_reward: The creature drops a strange metal that looks valuable and flees!
event_soldiers: You find the remains of a battle. A wounded pilot lies next to his wrecked Zoid, calling for help.
event_soldiers_help_heal: The grateful pilot shares his emergency repair supplies with you!
event_soldiers_help_trap: You step into the same trap that took the soldier down. Your Zoids take damage!
event_soldiers_search_ambush: Enemy reinforcements arrive while you're searching the remains!
event_soldiers_search_reward: You recover valuable metal from the destroyed Zoids!
event_stray: A Stray Zoid wanders aimlessly ahead, its eyes flickering. Without a pilot, it has lost all purpose.
event_stray_calm_ambush: The Stray Zoid panics and attacks!
event_stray_calm_buff: The Stray Zoid responds to your presence and joins your formation!
event_stray_ignore_damage: The Stray Zoid lashes out as you pass by!
event_stray_ignore_reward: As you walk past, you find parts the Zoid has shed. They're still worth something!
